summary: A committee authorizes its treasurer to pay an obligation only if funds are available.
realLife: The Converse County committee approved Foreman’s motion allowing the treasurer to pay the remainder of its state-party assessment subject to available funds and a convention deadline.
inGame: needs: the payment authorization, amount due, cash available and deadline.

turns.what: The treasurer sends the authorized amount.
turns.pulledBy: Available funds cover the balance when payment comes due.
turns.writesBack: The committee can trace the payment to the earlier vote.

turns.what: The treasurer brings the shortfall back to the committee.
turns.pulledBy: Available funds fall short before the deadline.
turns.writesBack: The approved limit still applies while members decide how to cover it.
